import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Find the residential area sensitive area with the largest area
query = text("""
SELECT name, area, geometry
FROM sensitive_area
WHERE category = 'RESIDENTIAL_AREA'
ORDER BY area DESC
LIMIT 1
""")
df = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print(df)

import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Get the name of the largest residential area
residential_area_name = df['name'].values[0]
print(f"Largest residential area: {residential_area_name}")

# Find the nearest air quality monitoring station to this residential area
# Using ST_Distance to find the closest station
query = text(f"""
SELECT aqs.id, aqs.name_en, 
       ST_Distance(aqs.coordinate::geography, 
                   ST_Centroid(sensitive_area.geometry)::geography) as distance
FROM air_quality_station aqs, sensitive_area
WHERE sensitive_area.category = 'RESIDENTIAL_AREA'
AND sensitive_area.name = '{residential_area_name}'
ORDER BY distance
LIMIT 1
""")
nearest_station = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print(nearest_station)
